question_en: Return the top-level table of contents of TS 38.214 (locating DL-scheduling content).
original_query: MATCH (sp:Spec {specNumber: '38.214'})-[:HAS_SECTION]->(sec:Section) RETURN sec.sectionNumber, sec.sectionTitle ORDER BY sec.sectionNumber
reference_query: MATCH (sp:Spec {specNumber: '38.214'})-[:HAS_SECTION]->(sec:Section) RETURN sp.specRelease AS specRelease, sec.sectionNumber AS sectionNumber, sec.sectionTitle AS sectionTitle ORDER BY specRelease, sectionNumber

cardinality_policy.notes: All retained release-final formal top-level Section observations, explicitly attributed to their release; no single edition is selected and no row cap is introduced.
